subject: Slippage sentinel: action log and rebaseline request
content:
From: Ellis Chen <ellis.chen@acuityhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Project Aurora — milestone slippage flag

Neha,

Quick note to flag that our internal pilot gate slipped by two weeks — vendor validation on the EMR connector took longer than expected. That pushes our evaluation close beyond the target 8/4 date.

We're tracking cause (data mapping and a compliance interview) but need a concrete updated MAP and a path for a soft close if the pilot completes partial scope. Can we get a rebaseline and a run-the-risk log? Also curious whether burst capacity or a short staffed pilot would reduce time-to-eval.

Thanks,
Ellis
Ellis Chen
Head of Digital Programs, Acuity Health
[Attachment: pilot-error-log.txt]

-----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Ellis Chen <ellis.chen@acuityhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Project Aurora — milestone slippage flag

Ellis — thanks for the heads up and the log. Sorry to hear about the connector delay. We've pulled together a proposed rebaseline and a short "slippage sentinel" action log so stakeholders can see tradeoffs. See attached: MAP_v2.xlsx (new target dates + decision gates).

Quick summary / asks: 
- Proposed rebaseline: move final evaluation target from 2028-08-04 to 2028-08-18 with a phased signoff (pilot-data, security verification, business acceptance).
- Short-term mitigations: temporary burst capacity for nightly re-index, an extra integration engineering sprint (3 days), and a target security interview slot this week.
- Please confirm whether partial-scope signoff (pilot-data only) would be acceptable as a dependency for procurement to start the SOW.

I'll schedule a 30m sync for Thu so we can align decisions and I will loop in Marcus for a quick pricing/ops read.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx (Excel, 62KB)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 26 Jul 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Acuity slippage — operational ask

Team — forwarding Ellis's log and Neha's proposed MAP. Two operational asks:
1) Approve one-time burst capacity (16 GPU-hours nightly for 5 nights) to accelerate re-index & connector validation.
2) Hold a short runbook for partial-scope acceptance so Procurement can start SOW when pilot-data signoff is achieved.

Risk notes (for the risk log entry):
- Risk: Partial integration gaps cause business acceptance delay. Likelihood: medium. Impact: medium-high (procurement pause).
- Mitigation: Burst capacity (reduces validation time), dedicated integration resource for 3 days, and early procurement trigger on partial signoff.

I can approve capacity for up to 20 GPU-hours under the standard sales-led discount; Marcus, need you to confirm cost impact and whether we can make a formal escalation to Dedicated capacity quota.

-Jordan
Director, Strategic Accounts

Ellis / Priya — thanks for confirming partial-scope signoff. Per our call, attached is the updated MAP_v2 (sheet: Rebaseline + Decision Gates) and a short escalation note for internal leadership so procurement can continue while we complete final acceptance.

Key decisions captured here: 
- New target close (full acceptance): 2028-08-18.
- Milestone A (pilot-data signoff) target: 2028-08-04 — acceptable as procurement trigger.
- Temporary burst capacity proposal: 5 nights x 16 GPU-hrs nightly. Cost options: full list price (~$2,400) or sales credit at 50% ($1,200). Attached BurstPricing-v1.xlsx with breakdown.

Action items: 
1) Ellis/Priya: confirm burst pricing option (list vs 50% credit) by EOD Wed 7/31.
2) Redwood: Marcus to issue a one-time billing note and Jordan to update the HubSpot deal stage to "Partial Acceptance - Procurement" so SDR/CS handoff is queued.
3) Security: final review of SOC2-excerpt — Karthik, please note any blocking follow-ups.

Escalation note (internal): We are logging this as a MAP slippage event — ID SLIP-ACU-07-28 — so leadership knows this deal had a schedule drift and used a procurement trigger on partial acceptance. This will be reviewed in tomorrow's revenue ops call.

Attachments: MAP_v2.xlsx, BurstPricing-v1.xlsx

Best,
